estimateUnsupported: Some selected task estimates are unavailable. Reload before editing the selection.
customUnsupported: Some selected field values are unavailable. Reload before editing the selection.
wait: Wait until the current save and list update finish, then try again.
notWritable: You can’t edit these tasks now.
missing: Some selected tasks aren’t loaded. Reload the selection, then try again.
ineligible: Archived or meeting tasks can’t be edited together. Change the selection, then try again.
changed: Some selected tasks changed since this field opened. Reload, then try again.
draft: Another selected task has an unsaved draft. Save or discard it first.
sectionRoots: Only top-level tasks can move between sections together.
dateRange: For some selected tasks the due date would be before the start date.
unconfirmed: The answer did not confirm every selected task. Reload before editing again.
customDescription: Apply this value to the selected tasks captured when this cell opened.
fieldUnavailable: Some selected field values are unavailable. Reload before editing the selection.
